Ariyo.g: kilesehi ārakattā ariyo sappuriso aṇumattepi pāpe na ramati.
taṁ taṁmaggavajjhehi kilesehi ārakattā ariyabhāvakarattā ariyaphalapaṭilābhakarattā ca ariyo.
ariyā tuṇhī nisīdantā na bālaputhujjanā viya nisīdanti, aññataraṁ kammaṭṭhānaṁ gahetvāva nisīdanti.
taṁtaṁmaggavajjhehi kilesehi ārakattā ariyabhāvakarattā ca ariyo.
ettha hi ariyasaddo suddhamattapariyāyova, na lokuttarapariyāyo.
ettha pana dutiyajjhānampi ariyo tuṇhībhāvo mūlakammaṭṭhānampi.
idha imesaṁyeva tiṇṇaṁ ṭhānānaṁ karaṇena ariyo ceva dassanasampanno ca veditabbo, na Buddhādayo na sotāpannā.

ariyo.g: Idaṁ pana sutvā acelo cintesi “samaṇo Gotamo ‘mayhaṁyeva maggo ca paṭipadā ca atthi, aññesaṁ natthī’ti maññati, handassāhaṁ amhākampi maggaṁ kathemī”ti.

ariyo.l: katamo pana so bho Ānanda ariyo sīlakkhandho
ariyo.g: ekekaṁ pucchi.
ayaṁ sattahi ratanehi parivuto cakkavattī viya sattahi aṅgehi parivuto “ariyo sammāsamādhī”ti vuccati.
etthāpi.
uttarapadalopena, puggalassa ariyabhāvakarattā ariyaṁ karotīti vā ariyo, ariyaphalapaṭilābhakarattā vā ariyaṁ phalaṁ labhāpeti janetīti ariyo.
ayaṁ pañho theriyā paṭipucchitvā vissajjetabbo bhaveyya “upāsaka tayā, heṭṭhā maggo pucchito, idha kasmā maggameva pucchasī”ti.

ariyo.l: Tīhi ca kho āvuso Visākha khandhehi ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅgahito
ariyo.g: ettha yasmā maggo sappadeso, tayo khandhā nippadesā, tasmā ayaṁ sappadesattā nagaraṁ viya rajjena nippadesehi tīhi khandhehi saṅgahito.
